title: HindsightPack
description: One national divergence, machine-readable (data/ships/hindsight/<slug>.json). A pack REFERENCES the 1922 base data and never modifies it. Packs are NOT overlays and DO NOT compose: there is no merge rule, and the 1936 snapshot is one authored thing the packs feed. A nation not toggled on loads its plain historical self and no pack at all.

toggle.description: The divergence's display name, e.g. "As Long As It's Black". Sixteen configurations of the four toggles are legal; FRA, ITA and USSR are never divergent.

as_of.description: The snapshot this pack describes. Play begins 1936-01-01, which sits on build_model.py's year boundary: END 1935 IS the 1 Jan 1936 fleet.

source.description: The prose canon files that own these facts. They win over this file in every disagreement.

file.description: The 1922 historical file this pack diverges from. Read-only.

retained_hulls.description: Base-file hull ids still afloat at as_of.

no_base_reason.description: Why this pack has no 1922 base file. A nation outside the Washington system may simply not exist in the seed data; saying so is better than inventing a base.

equipment_file.description: The equipment catalog whose SKUs this pack's classes reference.

build_model.description: The construction model that is the arbiter of every hull count in this pack. ROWS ARE END-OF-YEAR: a mid-year figure must lie between the previous year-end and that year-end. tools/validate.py checks the pack's counts against the model's own output.

derived.description: The emitted JSON of the model's year-by-year output.

envelope_t_equiv_yr.description: A NUMBER where the envelope is flat and AN OBJECT OF year -> t-equiv WHERE IT IS A RAMP. Japan's is flat and is a number; Germany's goes from 5,600 t-equiv a year to 104,000 in eight years and cannot be one, and forcing it into a scalar would hide the only interesting thing about it.

not_built.description: What this divergence means the nation did NOT do. A negative program is as much a fact as a positive one, and is the only place the money that paid for the divergence is visible.

aggregates.description: Counts for classes tracked in bulk rather than as named hulls — which for a navy that names only its battle line is most of the fleet.

assignment.description: Fleet, flotilla or station these ships are on at the pack's as_of date. The named-hull record has one; a navy that names nothing below its battle line needs it here or the information has nowhere to live.

pennants.description: Hull-number range, where the navy identifies these ships by number only.
